name: linkedin
description: Read your LinkedIn profile, share posts, and manage profile sections through the LinkedIn API.

interface.shortDescription: Read your profile, share posts, and manage LinkedIn from Caeros.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to LinkedIn through a local MCP server (@pegasusheavy/linkedin-mcp) signed in with your own LinkedIn account via OAuth. Fetch your profile and share posts out of the box; connection listing, people search, and profile-section editing tools are included and light up when the connected LinkedIn app has the corresponding LinkedIn API products approved.
defaultPrompt: What does my LinkedIn profile say about me?
